title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
contract: At most one buy followed by one later sell. Return the maximum nonnegative profit from nonnegative prices.
brute: long best=0;for(int buy=0;buy<a.length;buy++)for(int sell=buy+1;sell<a.length;sell++){best=Math.max(best,(long)a[sell]-a[buy]);emit("Try a buy/sell pair","days",new int[]{buy,sell},"best",best);}return best;
optimal: long min=Long.MAX_VALUE,best=0;for(int price:a){min=Math.min(min,price);best=Math.max(best,price-min);emit("Remember the cheapest prior opportunity","price",price,"minimum",min,"best",best);}return best;
reasoning: For a fixed selling day, the cheapest earlier price is always the best buy.
Keep the global answer at least zero to represent no transaction. This single-transaction state cannot directly solve cooldown or transaction-limit variants.
